generation.explanation: The discriminant D = b² − 4ac of a quadratic ax² + bx + c tells you how many times the parabola crosses the x-axis. When D > 0 there are two distinct real roots; when D = 0 the parabola just touches the axis at one repeated root; when D < 0 the parabola stays entirely above or below the axis and there are no real roots.
